from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values;A=df['A'].values;y=df['dA_dt'].values
var=np.var(y)
def fit(f,npar,n=40,seed=1):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);best=None
    for _ in range(n):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,npar); p0[0]=abs(p0[0])*5
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(f(p)-y,nan=1e6,posinf=1e6,neginf=-1e6),p0,max_nfev=2000)

        except Exception: pass
